question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (SpaceX)

calls.reasoning: Q3 2026 revenue (reported ~Nov 5). Consensus $12.9-13.1B; UBS $13.8B assumes Google's $920M/mo deal is fully in Q3. Bottom-up: Anthropic now at full $1.25B/mo (~$3.75B vs ~$1.6B cloud in Q2), legacy AI ~$1.1B, connectivity ~$4.6-4.9B, space ~$1.0-1.3B gives ~$10.7B without Google and ~$13.5B with it. Needham says most deals ramp in Q4 and $6.7B of contracted cloud revenue ramps from October, which argues against the bull case; the Q2 beat (+13%) argues the other way. Median near consensus, slightly shaded down. No prediction market found for this number.
calls.dossier:
- SpaceX (NASDAQ: SPCX) went public in mid-2026; xAI/X are consolidated as the 'AI' segment. Q3 2026 earnings are tentatively set for Nov 5, 2026 (investing.com, wallstreethorizon). The question presumably resolves off the Q3 2026 quarterly revenue in that report.
- Q1 2026 revenue $4.694B, of which AI $0.818B (S-1, May 2026).
- Q2 2026 revenue $7.8B (+92% YoY) vs consensus $6.9B; Space $0.962B, Connectivity $4.291B (+66%), AI $2.561B (+248%), of which ~$1.6B was new Colossus cloud deals (8-K earnings release / Fortune, Aug 4 2026). 12M Starlink subscribers.
- Anthropic compute deal: $1.25B/month through May 2029, discounted in May-June during ramp; 90-day exit clause (Axios May 20 2026; letsdatascience).
- Google compute deal: ~$920M/month (~$11B/yr), signed weeks after Anthropic (Fortune, Jul 19 2026); exact revenue start date unclear.
- Q2 call: an additional $6.7B of cloud services revenue over six months 'begins ramping starting in October' (24/7 Wall St, Oct 3 2026).
- Third deal: $1.11B/month starting Dec 1 2026, so no Q3 impact (Benzinga/qz, Sep 10 2026).
- Needham (Sep 2026): 'majority of deals expected to ramp in Q4 2026, with one beginning in December'; it trimmed its AI estimates.
- Consensus Q3 revenue: $12.9B (UBS citing Street); another aggregate gives $13.11B across 30 analysts. UBS forecasts $13.8B: AI $7.6B, Connectivity $4.9B (+59%), Space $1.3B (Yahoo/Stocktwits, Sep 29 2026).
- Management targets a $100B annualized revenue run rate by Dec 2026 (an exit-rate target, not Q3 guidance). No formal quarterly guidance is given.
- Bottom-up arithmetic: legacy AI ~$1.0-1.1B + Anthropic full quarter $3.75B + Connectivity $4.6-4.9B + Space $1.0-1.3B gives ~$10.4-11.0B without Google; adding a full quarter of Google (~$2.76B) gives ~$13.2-13.8B.
- Status quo: Q2 was $7.8B; the step-up depends on how much compute revenue is recognized in Q3.
- Markets: no Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold contract on SpaceX quarterly revenue found.
- Event window: next quarterly report after Sep 2026 (Q3, ~Nov 5 2026); as of Oct 11 the quarter has ended and the report is not yet out.
- Searched but not found: an exact Google revenue start date, any Q3 pre-announcement, company Q3 guidance.

calls.reconciliation: Main factual dispute: whether Google compute revenue is fully in Q3 (UBS and Runs 2-4 lean that way) or mostly in Q4. Run 4's dossier (TechCrunch: reduced fee through September, full payments from October), Run 1's statement that $6.7B of cloud revenue starts ramping in October, and Needham's 'majority ramp in Q4' all agree, so Google is only partial in Q3 and UBS's $7.6B AI figure looks too high. Anthropic's full quarter at $3.75B is agreed by all runs. Report date (Nov 3/5/17) is unresolved but does not affect the quantity. Weighting consensus and the beat history is a judgment call: I put the median between the bottom-up sum and consensus. No web access was available on this run, so nothing was verified beyond the dossiers.
